label: Transition — Nomad into Village
candidates: The paths you walked have hardened into stone.
The wanderers you met have built walls, or villages, or vanished entirely.
The ground you crossed is paved now, and people walk it in your color.
Settlements stand where there were only grey huddles before.
Where tribes held conviction long enough, they stopped moving and built.
The earth remembers your steps as stone; the fearful have dug in; the hopeful have raised roofs.
What was dirt when you slept is pavement now, and the grey who watched you have chosen sides or disappeared.
The trails are roads, the wanderers are builders, and the world has aged while you rested.
